title: StatusEnvelope
description:
The common part of every aggregate's status.

A kind's status embeds it with `#[serde(flatten)]` beside its own fields, so its fields
appear at the top level of the status.

commit_sequence.description: The sequence of the last commit of either lane.

control_receipt_ring.description: The control-receipt ring; present exactly on an aggregate with a control lane.

control_revision.description: The control lane's revision; zero on an aggregate without a control lane.

last_receipt_ref.description: The receipt of the last command committed on the aggregate; absent before the first.

observedGeneration.description:
The `metadata.generation` of the spec the owning controller last acted on; absent until
it first has.

pending_commit.description: The pending commit slot; absent until the first domain commit installs it.

AuditEnvelope.description:
The parts of a control commit's `AutoBotEvent` that neither its receipt nor its aggregate
holds.

With the receipt they give every field of the event: `aggregate_uid` is the aggregate's
UID, `lane` is `CONTROL`, `commit_sequence` and `control_revision` are the receipt's, `actor`
is its principal, `state_digest` is its after-control digest, and `event_digest` is computed
over the event.

causation_id.description: The identifier of what caused the event.

correlation_id.description: The identifier that correlates the event with others.

schema_version.description: The schema version of the event.

source_uid.description: The UID of the event's source.

state_revision.description: The aggregate's `state_revision` when the commit landed.

Condition.description:
One condition of an aggregate, in the form of the Kubernetes `metav1.Condition`.

`last_transition_time` is carried as text: the kernel does not interpret time.

lastTransitionTime.description: When the status last changed, in RFC 3339.

message.description: A human-readable account of the transition.

observedGeneration.description: The `metadata.generation` the condition was set from.

reason.description: Why the status last changed, in `CamelCase`.

ControlReceipt.description:
The receipt of one control commit, the FORMAL §2 `ControlReceipt` record.

The control commit appends it to the ring in the same write, so the receipt is durable
without a second write and its audit event can be rebuilt from it.

after_control_digest.description: The aggregate's control digest after the commit.

audit_envelope.description: The parts of the audit event the rest of the receipt does not hold.

before_control_digest.description: The aggregate's control digest before the commit.

commit_sequence.description: The commit's sequence on the aggregate.

control_uid.description: The UID of the control command.

principal.description: The authenticated writer of the control command.

ControlReceiptRing.description:
The bounded ring of control receipts of an aggregate with a control lane.

Entries are in commit order: each entry's commit sequence and control revision are past the
previous entry's, which deserialization checks. The bound is the profile's
[`ControlRing::entries`]: the ring is full when it holds that many unpublished receipts.
Published entries are kept while there is room and give way, oldest first, to new receipts.

ControlReceiptState.description: The state of a control receipt in the ring.

oneOf.description: The receipt's audit event is not yet published. The initial state.
The receipt's audit event is published.

ObjectRef.description:
A reference to one object: its namespace, name and UID.

The UID pins the reference to one incarnation of the name: an object deleted and created
again under the same name is a different object.

PendingCommit.description:
The pending commit a domain commit installs, the FORMAL §2 `PendingCommit` record.

The slot names its command's receipt, prepared before the commit, and the digest of its
audit event; with the effect intents it holds, that lets a new process finish the receipt
and rebuild the event from the slot alone.

after_digest.description: The aggregate's domain digest after the commit.

audit_digest.description: The digest of the commit's audit event.

before_digest.description: The aggregate's domain digest before the commit.

command_uid.description: The UID of the committed command.

commit_sequence.description: The commit's sequence on the aggregate.

control_revision_at_commit.description: The aggregate's `control_revision` when the commit landed.

effect_intents.description: The effect intents of the commit, in effect-index order.

receipt_uid.description: The UID of the command's receipt.

PendingCommitState.description: The state of an aggregate's pending commit slot.

oneOf.description:
The slot's receipt and audit event are written and verified; the next domain commit may
proceed. The initial state.
A domain commit installed the slot and its receipt barrier holds.
A new process is reconstructing the slot's receipt and audit event.

SlotEffectIntent.description:
One effect intent as a pending commit holds it.

It holds the fields of the FORMAL §2 `EffectIntent` record that the commit decides. The
rest follow from it: `aggregate_uid` is the UID of the aggregate whose slot holds the
intent, `committed_revision` is the slot's `proposed_revision`, `uid` and `operation_key`
are derived from those and the fields here, and `state` belongs to the `EffectIntent`
object materialized from it.

contract_revision.description: The revision of the provider contract the intent is written against.

desired_outcome.description: The outcome the effect is to produce.

effect_index.description: The position of the intent among the commit's intents.

installation_lineage.description: The installation lineage the intent's operation key binds.

payload_digest.description: The digest of the intent's payload.

provider_binding.description: The provider binding that is to carry out the effect.

target_identity.description: The identity of the effect's target at the provider.
